9:94: Ad awen ssutren ssmaḥ, ma tuɣalem d ɣuṛsen. Ini: "ur ssuturet ssmaḥ, ur kwen numin d awezɣi. Niɣ Imla yaɣ Ṛebbi asali nnwen. Ad Iẓeṛ Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, igiten nnwen. Sinna, a ţţuɣalem ar Umusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir, ad awen Imel ayen txeddmem".
9:95: Ad awen gren Ṛebbi, mi d tuɣalem ɣuṛsen, iwakken ad asen tanfem. Wexxeṛt asen; nitni, s tideţ, d laɛṛuṛ; axxam nnsen d Loahennama, d aqeṭṭi n wayen keţţben.
9:96: Ad awen ggalen iwakken a ten tṛaḍim. Ma tṛuḍam ten, ihi, Ṛebbi ur Iţṛaḍi agdud iballaɣen.
9:97: Aɛṛaben n ucluḥ zaden di tijehli akked nnxayel, zeggwiren ar uzgar n tilas id Issers Ṛebbi i Umazan iS. Ṛebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
9:98: Ger waɛṛaben n ucluḥ, wid iḥesben ayen seddqen d tabzert. Ggunin a ţţekḥes fellawen teswiɛt. Fellasen abeddel adiran n teswiɛt! Ṛebbi Issel, Issen.
9:99: Ger waɛṛaben n ucluḥ, wid iumnen s Ṛebbi d wass aneggaru, ḥesben ayen seddqen a ten iẓẓiẓ ar Ṛebbi akked tẓilla Umazan. Day mačči, s tideţ, d ayen ara ten iẓẓiẓen? A ten Issekcem Ṛebbi deg uḥunu S. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
9:100: Imenza i izwaren, seg iminigen, imɛiwnen, akked wid i ten iɛanden ar lewqama, Iṛuḍa ten Ṛebbi, ṛuḍan T. Ihegga yasen d leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, ad wekkṛen degsen, i lebda. D wagi ay d rrbeḥ ameqwṛaḥan.
9:101: Ger waɛṛaben n ucluḥ, i wen d izzin, llan at sin wudmawen, akw ger imezdaɣ n Lmadina. Zgan di nnxayel. Ur ten tessineḍ. Nekwni, Nessen iten. A ten Nɛaqeb berdayen, sinna, ad ţţunefken i uɛaqeb abarar.
9:102: Wiyad qaṛṛen s ibekkaḍen nnsen, ssemlalen igi ilhan d win nniḍen icemten. Izmer Ṛebbi ad asen Issuref. S tideţ, Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
9:103: Eddem ed ssadaqa seg wayla nnsen, a ten tezzizdeg, a ten tṣeffi. ẒẒẓal ilmend nnsen. Ih, tiẓilla k d talwit nnsen. Ṛebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
9:104: Day ur ẓṛin ara Ṛebbi, Neţţa, Iqebbel asteṛoaɛ sɣuṛ ixdimen iS? Iţţaṭaf ssadaqat. Ih, Ṛebbi Issuruf, Iţḥunu.
9:105: Ini: "xedmet! Ad Iwali igiten nnwen, Ṛebbi, Umazan iS, akked lmumnin. Tuɣalin nnwen ar Umusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir, ad awen Imel ayen txeddmem".
9:106: Wiyaḍ ţganin lameṛ n Ṛebbi, a ten Iɛaqeb, neɣ ad asen Issuref. Ṛebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
9:107: Wid irran loamaɛ i lemḍeṛṛa akked tijehli, i lefṛaq ger lmumnin; d taxettalt i wid, iuɣ lḥal, llan ţnaɣen Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, ad ggalen, war ccekk: "ay nebɣa siwa lewqama". Ad Icehhed Ṛebbi ar nitni, s tideţ, d ikeddaben.
9:108: Ur ţţili, degs, d awezɣi. Iklal kteṛ, tilin ik, loamaɛ ibnan ɣef uḥezzeb, seg wass amenzu. Degs irgazen i iḥemmlen ad izdigen. Ṛebbi Iḥemmel izedganen.
9:109: Day win issersen lebni s ɣef uḥezzeb i Ṛebbi akked llza, ur yif ara win issersen lebni s ɣef rrif n ucṛuf ara iseggxen? Iseggex yis ar tmes n Loahennama. Ṛebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
9:110: Izga lebni, bnan, iţţara ccekk deg ulawen nnsen, alamma gezmen wulawen nnsen. Ṛebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
9:111: Ih, Ṛebbi Iuɣ ar lmumnin, iman nnsen akked wayla nnsen, imi Loennet i nitni. Pnaɣen deg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Nnɣan, ţwanɣan. D lemɛahda fellas, s tideţ, di Tuṛa, di Linoil akked Leqwṛan. Anwa yifen Ṛebbi di tuṭṭfa n lemɛahda s? Feṛḥet, ihi, di ssuq tsewwqem. Wagi d rrbeḥ ameqwṛaḥan.
9:112: Wid isteṛoɛen, wid iɛabden, wid iţcekkiṛen, ixelwiyen, wid iṭṭinizen, wid ikennun, wid iţţamṛen lewqama, wid iţgeddilen ayen n dir, wid iţḥaraben ɣef tlisa n Ṛebbi ... Becceṛ lmumnin.
9:113: Ur issefk ara i Nnbi akked wid iumnen, ad ssutren ad ţwasemmḥen imcurak, xas ţţilin asen, ma iban asen d ar, nitni, war ccekk, d at tmes.
9:114: Ibṛahim ur issuter ara ad iţwasemmeḥ baba s, siwa ilmend n lemɛahda i s ifka. Mi s d iban ar neţţa d acengu n Ṛebbi, ifra ţ yides. Ibṛahim, war ccekk, iţţanez, iḥellem.
9:115: Ur ţ Ixeddem Ṛebbi, ad Itlef agdud mbaɛd ma Inha ten, alamma i sen Ibeggen acu ara ḥezzben. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Issen yal cci.
9:116: Ih, Ṛebbi, IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan, Issidir, Ineqq. Ur awen illi, war Ṛebbi, bab neɣ amɛiwen.
9:117: Niɣ Issuref Ṛebbi i Nnbi akked iminigen, akked imɛiwnen i iddan yides, di lweqt uwɛiṛ, mbaɛd ma qṛib nneqlaben wulawen n urbaɛ segsen. Sinna, Issuref asen. Ih, Neţţa, i nitni, dUmɛin, d'Aḥnin.
9:118: U i kraḍ id igwran, armi, tamurt iwsɛan, tediyyeq fellasen. Vaqen deg iman nnsen. Ufan ur illi ssṛan si Ṛebbi, siwa Neţţa. Sinna, Issuref asen, akken ad steṛoɛen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Issuruf, Iţḥunu.
9:119: A wid iumnen! Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, ilit seg imawlan n tideţ.
9:120: Ur issefk ara i imezdaɣ n Lmadina, d wayen i sen d izzin n waɛṛaben n ucluḥ, ad gwrin deffir Umazan n Ṛebbi, neɣ ad smenyafen iman nnsen i iman is. Ayagi, acku ur ten iţḥaz fad, neɣ ɛaggu, neɣ llaẓ, deg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Ur kečmen akal ara isserfun ijehliyen, ur ţţaṭṭafen acemma sɣuṛ ucengu, siwa ma dayen i sen iuran d igi n wayen ilhan. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Isṛuḥu arraz iɛaṛḍiyen.
9:121: Ur ţṣeṛṛifen cwiṭ neɣ aṭas, ur zeggren asif, siwa ma iura yasen, iwakken a ten Ikafi Ṛebbi ɣef wayen ilhan deg wayen xeddmen.
9:122: Ur Issefk ara i lmumnin ad ffɣen akw. Awufan ad iffeɣ ugraw si yal arbaɛ, ad ɣbun di ddin, ad nabin agdud nnsen, mara uɣalen ɣuṛsen. Amar ad steḥdren.
9:123: A wid iumnen! Nnaɣet ijehliyen i kwen iqeṛben. Ad afen, ɣuṛwen, teqseḥ. Cfut, Ṛebbi Iţţili d wid iţḥezziben.
9:124: Mi d ters tsuṛeţ, llan garasen wid iqqaṛen: "anwa degwen, iwumi terna tagi, di liman"? Ma d wid iumnen, terna yasen liman, u nitni feṛḥen.
9:125: Ma d wid iwumi blan wulawen, terna ammus i wammus nnsen. Mmuten u nitni d ijehliyen.
9:126: Day ur walan ara, ar nitni la d sskaren lfetna, yal aseggwas, yiwen ubrid neɣ berdayen? Sinna, ur steṛoiɛen, ur d smektayen.
9:127: Mi d ters tsuṛeţ, ad mesmuqalen: "day illa yiwen ikwen id Iţwalin"? Sinna, ad wexxṛen. Isswexxeṛ Ṛebbi ulawen nnsen, imi nitni d agdud ur nfehhem.
9:128: Niɣ iusa kwen id Umazan seg iman nnwen. Ẓẓay fellas laɛtab nnwen. Iţḥarab fellawen, d umɛin, d aḥnin i lmumnin.
9:129: Ma wexxṛen, ini: "Iqadd iyi Ṛebbi. Ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa. FellaS ţţekleɣ. Neţţa d Mass n usgeld ameqwṛaḥan.
10:1: Alṛ, wigi d issekniyen n Tezmamt tuṣwibt.
10:2: Day d lwehma, i medden, ma Nweḥḥa n i urgaz nnsen: "nabi imdanen, becceṛ wid iumnen ar ad afen arraz umɛin ar Mass nnsen"? Nnan ijehliyen: "wagi, s tideţ, d aseḥḥar n ṣṣeḥ".
10:3: Ih, Mass nnwen d Ṛebbi, i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan di sdis wussan. Sinna, Iɛannec ɣef usgeld, Iseyyi lameṛ. Ur illi umcafaɛ siwa ma Iɛammed as. D wagi ay d Ṛebbi, Mass nnwen. Ihi, ɛabdet eP. Day ur d tesmektayem ara?
10:4: ɣuṛeS akw tuɣalin nnwen. Lemɛahda n Ṛebbi d tideţ. Ih, Inezzu axlaq, Iţţales, iwakken ad Ikafi wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, s lmizan. I wid ijehlen, tissit iṛɣan, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan, imi llan jehlen.
10:5: D Neţţa i Irran iṭij d lefnaṛ, aggur d tafat. Iwezn as tiswaɛin, iwakken a ţţissinem amḍan iseggwasen, akked leḥsab. Ur Ixliq Ṛebbi ayagi, siwa s tideţ. Iţfeṣṣil issekniyen i ugdud issnen.
10:6: S tideţ, di lemgarda ger yiḍ akked wass, akked wayen Ixleq Ṛebbi di tmurt akked igenwan, ard issekniyen i ugdud i iţḥezziben.
10:7: Ih, wid ur negguni ara timlilit yidneɣ, i tqennaɛ tmeddurt di ddunit, u rekden degs, d wid i istehzan ɣef issekniyen nneɣ.
10:8: Wigi, axxam nnsen di tmes, ilmend n wayen keţţben.
10:9: Ih, wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, a ten Inhu Mass nnsen, s liman nnsen. Ad ţţazzalen isaffen seddawat sen, di leonanat isaɛdiyen.
10:10: Anuju nnsen degs: "gedha s yissek a Ṛebbi"! Azul nnsen d: "tifrat". Anuju nnsen aneggaru: "ccekṛan i Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen".
10:11: Lemmer ad Iaɛoel Ṛebbi cceṛṛ ar imdanen, akken nitni ḥaren ɣef lxiṛ, yili ibbweḍ asen lajel nnsen. A Nanef i wid ur negguni ara timlilit yidneɣ, ad ddebdben di lbeɣwḍ nnsen.
10:12: Amdan, ma iḥuza t ccqa, ad aɣ ɣ d isiwel, iẓẓel, iqqim neɣ ibedd. Mi s Nekkes ccqa s, ad iteddu amzun ur d inuj ɣuṛneɣilmend n ccqa i t iḥuzan. Akka ay ţţucebḥen igiten nnsen i imaɛfan.
10:13: Niɣ Nesqucc isuta, uqbel nnwen, imi densen. Ussan d ɣuṛsen imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen, ur llin d wid ara iamnen. Akka ay Neţqeṭṭi agdud ibeɣwḍiyen.
10:14: Sinna, Nerra kwen d igensas di tmurt, deffir sen, a Nwali amek ara txedmem.
10:15: Ma ɣṛan asen issekniyen nneɣ iberrzen, wid ur negguni ara timlilit yidneɣ, ad inin: "awi d Leqwṛan nniḍen, neɣ beddel it". Ini: "ur felli a t beddleɣ, s lebɣi n yiman iw. Tedduɣ kan akked wayen iyi d iţţuweḥḥan. Nek ugadeɣ, ma xedɛaɣ Mass iw, aɛaqeb n wass ameqwṛaḥan".
10:16: Ini: "lemmer i S ihwi i Ṛebbi, ur awen t id mliɣ, ur awen t id mmektiɣ. Niɣ zedɣeɣ yidwen tameddurt, uqbel is. Day ur tfehmem ara"?
10:17: Anwa i idensen kteṛ, ger win id igren tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi, neɣ win inekṛen issekniyen iS? Ih, ur rebḥen ibeɣwḍiyen.
10:18: La ɛabden, war Ṛebbi, ayen ur ten neṭṭuṛu, ur ten nenfaɛ. La qqaṛen: "wigi d imcafɛen nneɣ ar Ṛebbi". Ini: "day a ţxebbṛem Ṛebbi ɣef wayen ur Issin, di tmurt akked igenwan"? Gedha s yiS! I Aɛlay sennig wayen ţcaraken!
10:19: Llan imdanen d yiwen n lois kan. Sinna, mgaraden. Lemmer ur d izwar ara wawal, sɣuṛ Mass ik, ad yili uḥuddu, garasen, ɣef wayen iɣef mgaraden.
10:20: La qqaṛen: "a lemmer id irs ɣuṛes ussekni n Mass is"! Ini: "tabaḍnit ar Ṛebbi kan. Ihi, gganit. Nek, yidwen, seg wid iggunin".
10:21: Ma Nesḥess i imdanen aḥunu, deffir twaɣit i ten iḥuzan, atnan la ţţandin i issekniyen nneɣ. Ini: "Ṛebbi Yif akw akken Iţɣawal di tiḥeṛci". Imersulen nneɣ, s tideţ, ţţarun ayen teţţandim.
10:22: Neţţa i kwen Iţţawin di lberr, di yill. Alamma, mi tellam di lembwabeṛ, teţţedum degsen s waḍu uṣwib, feṛḥen yis, tusa d tbuciḍant ɣuṛsen, ţţasent ed lemwao ɣuṛsen, si yal tama, ḥulfan a d tezzi fellasen. Naɛṛen Ṛebbi, s lqaɛida i Neţţa: "ma Tsellkeḍ aɣ si tagi, ar a nili seg wid isnemmiren".
10:23: Mi ten Isellek, imiren uɣalen beɣwḍen di tmurt, war ssebba. A yimdanen! Lbeɣwḍ nnwen, siwa ɣef yiman nnwen. Zzhu di tmeddurt n ddunit, sinna, ɣuṛneɣ tuɣalin nnwen, ad awen Nmel ayen txeddmem.
10:24: Amedya n tmeddurt di ddunit, am aman kan. Nesseɣli ten id seg igenni, xelḍen akked imɣan n tmurt, iseg teţţen imdanen akked lmal. Mi tcebbeḥ tmurt, tuɣal d tuzyint, ɣilen, imezdaɣ is, ar deg ufus nnsen ay tella. Iusa ţ id lameṛ nneɣ, deg iḍ, neɣ deg wass, Nerra ţ d ahicuṛ, amzun ur teoouoeg ass izeryen. Akka ay Nfeṣṣel issekniyen i ugdud iţxemmimen.
10:25: Inecced Ṛebbi s axxam n tifrat. Inehhu win i S ihwan, ar ubrid uwqim.
10:26: I wid iweqmen, lewqama, ternuḍ as. Udmawen nnsen, ur ten iţnal bufsus, neɣ ddell. Widak, d at Loennet, nitni, degs ad wekkṛen.
10:27: Aqeṭṭi n wid id ibbwin tucmitin, d tucmiţ itent icban. Ad ndellen. Ur sɛun amenḥul ar Ṛebbi. Amzun ɣummen wudmawen nnsen, s cceḍyat n yiḍ iberkanen. Widak d at tmes, nitni, degs, ad wekkṛen.
10:28: Ass ideg ara ten Nfesser akw, a Nini, imiren, i wid icurken: "imukan nnwen, kunwi akked icriken nnwen"! Sinna Nessemfaṛaq iten. A d inin, icriken nnsen: "mačči d nekwni ay tɛabdem.
10:29: Ad Iqadd Ṛebbi, d Anagi garaneɣ yidwen, ar ur d necliɛ deg uɛbbed nnwen".
10:30: Din, yal amdan ad iwali ayen iwasa. Ad uɣalen ar Ṛebbi, Bab nnsen n tideţ. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.
10:31: Ini: "anwa ikwen Iţɣitin seg igenni akked tmurt? Anwa ay d Bab n tmejjin akked yiẓṛi? Anwa id Issuffuɣen amuddir si lmegget, id Issuffuɣen lmegget seg umuddir? Anwa i Iseyyin lameṛ"? A d inin: "d Ṛebbi". Ini: "ihi, day ur teţḥezzibem ara"?
10:32: D wagi ay d Ṛebbi, Mass nnwen n tideţ. Deffir tideţ, acu i illan, siwa ttelfan? Ihi, acimi texdɛam?
10:33: Akka i iṣaṛ wawal n Mass ik, ɣef wid ixedmen tucmitin. Ih, nitni ur ţţamnen.
10:34: Ini: "day illa ger icriken nnwen, win id inzan lxelq, sinna, iules as d"? Ini: "Ṛebbi inezzu lxelq, sinna, Iţţales as d. Ihi, amek ara twexxṛem"?
10:35: Ini: "day illa, ger icriken nnwen, win i inehhun ar tideţ"? Ini: "Ṛebbi Inehhu ar tideţ. Win Inehhun ar tideţ, day ur Yif ara, akken Iklal tikli yideS, win ur nennehhu, siwa ma iţwanha? Acu ikwen iuɣen? Amek teţseyyim"?
10:36: Tegwti, segsen, teddun kan d nnwaya. Nnwaya, war ccekk, ur tebbwi acemma si tideţ. Ih, Ṛebbi Issen acu xeddmen.
10:37: Leqwṛan agi ur d innulfa ara, war Ṛebbi. Maca, d atebbet n wayen it id izwaren, d afeṣṣel n Tezmamt, ur degs ccekk, sɣuṛ Mass imaḍalen.
10:38: Neɣ la qqaṛen: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "awit ed tasuṛeţ i t icban, neccdet seg wanda tzemrem, war Ṛebbi, ma tessawalem tideţ".
10:39: Xaṭi, skaddben ayen ur nekcim di tmusni nnsen, ur ten id iusi usefhem is. Akka ay skaddben, wid i ten id izwaren. Wali, ihi, amek teḍṛa d imednas.
10:40: Garasen, wid iumnen yis; garasen, wid ur numin yis. Mass ik Yif akw akken Issen ifessaden.
10:41: Ma skaddben k, ini: "i nek igiten iw, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Ur teţţkam deg wayen xedmeɣ, ur ţţkaɣ deg wayen txedmem".
10:42: Garasen, llan wid i k issemḥasen. Day tzemreḍ a ţţerreḍ ad slen iɛeẓẓugen, ma llan ur fehhmen?
10:43: Garasen, llan wid i k iţmuqulen. Day tzemreḍ a ţţenhuḍ iderɣalen, ma llan ur ţwalin?
10:44: Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Iddennis imdanen, s wacemma, maca imdanen densen iman nnsen.
10:45: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser, amzun sɛaddan kan saɛa n wass, ad msaɛqalen. Niɣ xesṛen wid iskaddben timlilit d Ṛebbi. Ur ţwanhan.
10:46: Ad ak Nessken kra seg wayen i sen Nɛahed, neɣ a k id Nawi ɣuṛneɣ. Ihi, ɣuṛneɣ tuɣalin nnsen. Sinna, Ṛebbi d Anagi n wayen xeddmen.
10:47: I yal lois, amazan. Ma iusa d umazan nnsen, a ţţefru garasen s lmizan, ur ţwadensen.
10:49: Ini: "ur mlikeɣ i iman iw ḍḍeṛṛ, neɣ abaɣuṛ, siwa ayen Ibɣa Ṛebbi. Yal lois s lajel is". Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ur t swexxiṛen s saɛa, ur t id sseqṛaben.
10:50: Ini: "acu twalam, ma iusa kwen id uɛaqeb iS, deg iḍ, neɣ deg wass? Acimi ḥaren ɣuṛeS ibeɣwḍiyen?
10:51: Dɣa, ma iusa d, a ţţamnem yis? Tura, aql akwen tɣeṣbem fellas".
10:52: Sinna, ad asen inin i wid idensen: "jeṛṛbet aɛaqeb n lebda. Ma teţţuqeṭṭan siwa kan ɣef wayen tkeţţbem"?
10:53: Steqsayen k: "d tideţ ayagi"? Ini: "ih, s Mass iw, ar ayagi d tideţ! Kunwi ur tezmirem i usfunneg".
10:54: Xas ad isɛu, yal amdan idensen, i illan di tmurt, ur d ifeddu yis. Ffren nndama mi walan aɛaqeb. Aḥuddu garasen, s lmizan, ur ţwadensen.
10:55: Day, s tideţ, mačči n Ṛebbi i illan di tmurt akked igenwan? Ih, day lemɛahda n Ṛebbi mačči d tideţ? Maca, tegwti segsen ur ssinen.
10:57: A yimdanen! Niɣ iusa kwen id unabi sɣuṛ Mass nnwen, akked ccfa n wayen iblan ulawen, akked nnhaya, akked uḥunu i lmumnin.
10:58: Ini: "s lfeḍl n Ṛebbi akked uḥunu S, s waya, xas ad feṛḥen". Yif ayen ţkemmimen.
10:59: Ini: "twalam ayen i wen d Issers Ṛebbi n ṛṛeẓq? Terram segs leḥlal d leḥṛam". Ini: "Iɛammed awen Ṛebbi, neɣ tesnulfam d ɣef Ṛebbi"?
10:60: Acu ara meyyzen, ass n tnekra, wid id igren tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi? Ih, Ṛebbi d Bab n lfeḍl af imdanen, maca tegwti segsen ur snemmiren.
10:61: Ur teţţiliḍ di liḥala, ur temmaleḍ si Leqwṛan, ur teţceɣwilem di kra, mebla ma Nella d Inagan nnwen, mara tweqmem. Lmizan ubelkim di tmurt u deg igenni, ur idrig i Mass ik. Akken seddaw waya, neɣ sennig es. Akw, di Tezmamt iţbegginen.
10:62: Ih, s tideţ, iḥbiben n Ṛebbi ur ţţagwaden, ur ɣweblen.
10:64: a ten beccṛen s lxiṛ di tmeddurt n ddunit, di laxeṛt. Ur illi ubeddel deg wawalen n Ṛebbi. D wagi ay d rrbeḥ ameqwṛaḥan.
10:65: Ur k iɣwebbel wawal nnsen. Ih, tazmert akw n Ṛebbi. Neţţa Isell, d Amusnaw.
10:66: S tideţ, day mačči n Ṛebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt? D acu ṭṭafaṛen wid iţnujun, war Ṛebbi, ar icriken? Ṭṭafaṛen kan nnwaya. Oaɛɛlen kan.
10:67: Neţţa, i wen Irran iḍ i ureyyeḥ nnwen, ass iwakken a ţwalim. Deg waya, s tideţ, d issekniyen i ugdud isellen.
10:68: Nnan: "Ṛebbi Isɛa aqcic. Gedha s yiS! Neţţa d Ameṛkanti. IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ur tesɛim adabu ɣef waya. Day a d tinim ɣef Ṛebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?
10:69: Ini: "s tideţ, wid id igren tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi, ur rebḥen".
10:70: Zzhu di ddunit, sinna, ɣuṛneɣ tuɣalin nnsen. Dɣa, ad asen Nsɛaddi aɛaqeb uqsiḥ, imi llan jehlen.
10:71: Eḥku yasen d tadyant n Nuḥ, mi inna i ugdud is: "a yagdud iw! Ma ẓẓayit fellawen tilin iw, akked usmekti w n issekniyen n Ṛebbi, ɣef Ṛebbi ţţekleɣ, ihi, zduklet lameṛ nnwen akked icriken nnwen. Sinna, ur awen teţţili lhejna ɣef lameṛ nnwen, dɣa, frut eţ felli, ur iyi sganit.
10:72: Ma twexxṛem, ur awen ssutureɣ taqdiɛt. Ih, taqdiɛt iw ar Ṛebbi kan. Felli lameṛ ad iliɣ seg imḍuɛen.
10:73: Skaddben t. Nsellek it, akked wid illan yides, di lbabuṛ. Nerra ten d igensas. Neɣmeq wid iskaddben issekniyen nneɣ. Wali amek teḍṛa d wid iţţunedṛen.
10:74: Sinna, deffir es, Nuzen ed imazanen ar igduden nnsen. Usan ten id s ubeggen. Ur ssawḍen ad amnen ɣef wayen nekṛen zik. Akka ay Nselleɣ ulawen ixabiten.
10:75: Sinna, deffir sen, Nuzen ed Musa akked Haṛun, ar Ferɛun akked imḍebbṛen is, s issekniyen nneɣ. Smeɣwṛen iman nnsen. Llan d agdud ibeɣwḍiyen.
10:76: Mi ten id tusa tideţ, sɣuṛneɣ, nnan: "wagi, ih, d ssḥur n ṣṣeḥ".
10:77: Inna Musa: "day a tinim d ssḥur wagi, i tideţ mi kwen id tusa"? Ur rebḥen iseḥḥaren.
10:78: Nnan: "day d tusiḍ ɣuṛneɣ, ad aɣ tesṭixxṛeḍ seg wayen id nufa ar imezwura nneɣ, a ţţuɣalem, di sin, d imeqwṛanen di tmurt? Ur numin, nekwni, yiswen".
10:79: Inna Ferɛun: "awit iyi d yal aseḥḥar amusnaw".
10:80: Mi d usan iseḥḥaren, inna yasen Musa: "ḍeggṛet ara tḍeggṛem"!
10:81: Mi ḍeggṛen, inna Musa: "ayen d tebbwim d ssḥur. S tideţ, a t Inqeḍ Ṛebbi". Ih, Ṛebbi ur Issewqam ara igiten ifessaden.
10:82: Ṛebbi Itebbit tideţ, s wawal iS, xas ugin ibeɣwḍiyen.
10:83: I iumnen s Musa, siwa tarwa seg ugdud is, ilmend n tugdi uhewwel n Ferɛun akked imḍebbṛen is. Ih, Ferɛun d abeɣwḍi di tmurt. Neţţa, s tideţ, seg imaɛfan.
10:84: Inna Musa: "a yagdud iw! Ma teţţamnem s Ṛebbi, ţţeklet fellaS ma d imḍuɛen ay tellam".
10:85: Nnan: "neţţkel ɣef Ṛebbi. A Mass nneɣ, ur aɣ ţţara d ahewwel i ugdud imednas;
10:86: Sellek aɣ, s uḥunu K, seg ugdud ijehliyen".
10:87: Nweḥḥa i Musa akked gma s: "ebnut ixxamen i ugdud nnwen di Maṣeṛ, erret ixxamen nnwen ar lqibla, beddet i tẓallit. Becceṛ lmumnin".
10:88: Inna Musa: "a Mass nneɣ! S tideţ, Tefkiḍ i Ferɛun akked imḍebbṛen is, ṛṛḥuḥ akked wayla di tmeddurt n ddunit, a Mass nneɣ, iwakken ad nnetlafen seg ubrid iK. A Mass nneɣ, Squcc ayla nnsen, Sɣeṛ ulawen nnsen, ur ţţamnen alamma walan aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan".
10:89: Inna: "ih, teţwaqbel tnaɛṛit nnwen. Ddut di lewqam, ur teddut d ubrid n wid ur nessin".
10:90: Nezzger At Isṛail di yill. Vefṛen ten Ferɛun akked iɛsekṛiwen is, s lebɣweḍ d lewɛaṛa. Armi ibbweḍ ad iɣmeq, inna: "umneɣ! Ih, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Win is umnen At Isṛail. Nek seg imḍuɛen".
10:91: Tura! Niɣ zik taɛṣaḍ, telliḍ seg ifessaden.
10:92: Assa, a Nsellek loeţţa k, a d tegwri d assekni i wid ara k id ineṣfen. Aṭas n medden, s tideţ, stehzan deg issekniyen nneɣ.
10:93: Niɣ Nessers At Isṛail deg umkan umɛin, u Nɣat iten s wayen ilhan. Ur mgaraden armi ten id tusa tussna. Ih, Mass ik ad Iḥudd garasen, ass n tnekra, ilmend n wayen iɣef llan mgaraden.
10:94: Ma tcukkeḍ ɣef wayen i k ed Nessers, steqsi wid i iqqaṛen Tazmamt, uqbel ik. Niɣ tusa k id tideţ, sɣuṛ Mass ik, ur ţţili seg wid iţcukkun.
10:95: Ur ţţili seg wid i iskaddben issekniyen n Ṛebbi, a ţţiliḍ seg imexsuṛen.
10:96: Ih, wid iɣef iṣaṛ Wawal n Mass ik, ur ţţamnen,
10:97: xas usan ten id akw issekniyen, alamma walan aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
10:98: A lemmer telli temdint iumnen, u infaɛ ţ liman is, siwa agdud n Yunes! Mi umnen, Nḍeṛṛef segsen aɛaqeb imdelli di tmeddurt n ddunit. Neooa ten zzhan tallit kan.
10:99: Ma ihwa yaS i Mass ik, ad amnen wid illan di ddunit, akken ma llan. Day a ţḥeţţmeḍ, kečč, i imdanen ad amnen?
10:100: Ur iţţamen umdan siwa ma Irad Ṛebbi. Isdullu wid ur nfehhem ara.
10:101: Ini: "walit i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Ula iwumi issekniyen akked ineddiṛen, i ugdud ur neţţamen".
10:102: Day a ţganin kan amedya n wussan n wid i ten id izwaren? Ini: "gganit, nek yidwen, seg wid iţganin".
10:103: Sinna, a Nsellek imazanen nneɣ, akked wid iumnen. Akka ay d lwajeb fellaɣ, a Nsellek lmumnin.
10:104: Ini: "a yimdanen! Ma tcukkem di ddin iw, nek ur ɛabdeɣ wid tɛabdem, war Ṛebbi. Maca, ɛabdeɣ Ṛebbi ara Idmen leṛwaḥ nnwen. Pwamṛeɣ ad iliɣ si lmumnin".
10:105: Sbedd udem ik i ddin, s umili ar tideţ, ur ţţili seg imcurak.
10:106: Ur ţnuju, war Ṛebbi, ar wayen ur k inefɛan, ur k iṭṭuṛṛun. Ma txedmeḍ akken, kečč, imiren, a ţţiliḍ seg imednas.
10:107: Ma Isɛadda fellak Ṛebbi ccqa, ur ak illi ujebbaṛ siwa Neţţa. Ma Irad ak lxiṛ, ur illi usebṭṭel i lfeḍl iS. Iţţak it i win i S ihwan, deg ixdimen iS. Neţţa Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
10:108: Ini: "a yimdanen! Niɣ tusa kwen id tideţ sɣuṛ Mass nnwen! Win iţwanhan, iţwanha kan i iman is; win innetlafen, innetlef kan i iman is. Ur lliɣ, nek, d awkil nnwen".
10:109: Ddu d wayen ik ed iţţuweḥḥan, eṣbeṛ ard Iḥudd Ṛebbi. Neţţa, Yif akw imḥaddan.
11:1: Alṛ. Tazmamt, issekniyen iS ţţuṣewwben, sinna, ţţufeṣṣlen sɣuṛ Uṣwib i Iţwaxebbṛen.
11:2: Ur ɛabdet siwa Ṛebbi. Nek, sɣuṛeS ɣuṛwen, d aneddaṛ u d abcir.
11:3: Ssutret ssmaḥ i Mass nnwen, steṛoɛet aS, ad Ifeṛṛeo fellawen afeṛṛeo ilhan, ar lajel iţwassnen. Iţţak lfeḍl iS i yal bab n lfeḍl. Ma twexxṛem, nekk ugadeɣ a ţţeţţuɛqbem, ass ameqwran.
11:4: Tuɣalin nnwen, ar Ṛebbi. Neţţa Izmer i yal cci.
11:5: Day nitni, s tideţ, ur snefḍasen ara idmaren nnsen, iwakken ad ffren fellaS? Xas ɣummen s iceṭṭiḍen nnsen, day ur Iẓṛa ara ayen teffren akked wayen d qqaṛen? Neţţa, s tideţ, Issen i illan deg idmaren.
